The booking sites at Nashville hotels

59 sites, 15 of them at one hotel only. Most hotels listed: Booking.com at 13, Hotels.com at 13, Priceline at 13, Agoda at 12 and the hotel's own site at 12. Fewest sites: Homewood Suites by Hilton Nashville-Downtown (8); most: Grand Hyatt Nashville (28).

Booking.com was lowest at Millennium Hotel Maxwell House Nashville of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 10. Hotels.com was lowest at Millennium Hotel Maxwell House Nashville of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 11. Priceline was lowest at none of its 13, and 5%+ above another site at 11.

The hotel's own site, at 12 of the 14: lowest at none, a median 27% above the lowest site. Nearest: Omni Nashville Hotel, $349 against $348 on BusinessHotels.com. Farthest: Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville, $270 against $180 on Vio.com, goseek.com and Etrip.net.

Lowest at 5%+ below the going rate: Super.com at 6, Traveluro at 3, Vio.com at 2, Agoda at 1, Etrip.net at 1, goseek.com at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1 (ties count for each). All cities: which booking site was lowest most often.

How far apart the sites were in Nashville

A site was 5% or more below the going rate at 10 of the 14 (median 24%, $66 a night; before tax, the study counted 10):

  • DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Nashville Downtown: 29% below, on Traveluro
  • Loews Nashville Hotel at Vanderbilt Plaza: 29% below, on Super.com
  • Virgin Hotels Nashville: 28% below, on Traveluro and Super.com
  • The 121 Hotel: 27% below, on Agoda
  • Sheraton Music City Nashville Airport: 24% below, on Traveluro
  • The Nashville Reserve, by Oliver: 24% below, on Super.com and Vio.com
  • Holiday Inn Nashville-Vanderbilt (Dwtn) by IHG: 21% below, on Super.com
  • Holiday Inn Express & Suites Nashville Southeast - Antioch by IHG: 21% below, on Super.com
  • Grand Hyatt Nashville: 18% below, on Vio.com, goseek.com and Etrip.net
  • The Westin Nashville: 9% below, on Super.com and trivago DEALS

Closest together: Homewood Suites by Hilton Nashville-Downtown, 8 sites, $277 to $285. Widest apart, lowest and highest site:

  • Loews Nashville Hotel at Vanderbilt Plaza: $207 on Super.com, $1,019 on Clicktrip.com
  • DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Nashville Downtown: $185 on Traveluro, $745 on Clicktrip.com
  • Holiday Inn Nashville-Vanderbilt (Dwtn) by IHG: $148 on Super.com, $238 on Evendo
  • Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville: $180 on Vio.com, goseek.com and Etrip.net, $286 on HotelTonight.com
  • Holiday Inn Express & Suites Nashville Southeast - Antioch by IHG: $119 on Super.com, $179 on Evendo

Google's free cancellation label was on a site's lowest listing at 9 of the 14, on the lowest price at 1 (Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville); at the other 8 it cost a median $33 (13%) more. Is it worth it?

A lower price may be a smaller room or a non-refundable rate.

Taxes and fees in Nashville

They added a median of 17.5% ($43 a night) to the before-tax going rate. It ran from 14.2% at Loews Nashville Hotel at Vanderbilt Plaza to 18.4% at Sheraton Music City Nashville Airport; our data does not split taxes from fees. The 5 listed prices may leave out resort or property fees. More: hotel booking fees explained.

Nashville, priced again a week later

Same stay, same Nashville hotels, 7 days apart, before tax; up and down mean more than 2%. Each stay links its CSV.

  • Oct 13 to Oct 15 stay, Sep 22 then Sep 29: 1 up, 3 down of 5; rose most Delta Hotels Nashville Airport, $169 to $173; fell most Millennium Hotel Maxwell House Nashville, $106 to $90; another site lowest at 3.
  • Oct 30 to Nov 1 stay, Sep 25 then Oct 2: 2 up, 7 down of 15; rose most Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville, $157 to $255; fell most Homewood Suites by Hilton Nashville-Downtown, $284 to $217; another site lowest at 10.

One week is no rule for when to book.

Questions about Nashville hotel prices

How much is a hotel in Nashville?

$290 a night all-in at the median (Sep 25, 2026 prices), from $148 at Sheraton Music City Nashville Airport to $426 at Virgin Hotels Nashville.

Does our data show the cheapest time to book a hotel in Nashville?

No: these prices come from a few Nashville dates, not a season. Sep 25 to Oct 2: 2 Nashville hotels rose more than 2%, 7 fell; Sports Illustrated Resorts Nashville rose most, $157 to $255 before tax.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Nashville hotels?

Below the going rate, most often Super.com (6 hotels), Traveluro (3 hotels) and Vio.com (2 hotels). The hotel's own site: lowest at none of 12.

How we measured this

The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price). The study's method. Words last changed November 23, 2026; prices read September 25, 2026; each hotel's page has every site's price in the newest snapshot that priced it.

Nearest medians to Nashville's: Los Angeles $303, London $277, Chicago $276, Cancun $233.
